sources.summary: This week on Dezeen, technology brand Dyson launched its first toothbrush, which includes a mouthwash spray designed to replace flossing. Named Dyson CameraJet, the electric toothbrush combines brushing, flossing and mouth-washing into one device. It includes a mouthwash jet that is directed by a camera to remove plaque between teeth. Speaking to Dezeen in an interview The post This week Dyson unveiled its first electric toothbrush appeared first on Dezeen .
